subject: Add invalid RDB signature to log statement (#2710)
reason: The change only appends the first 9 bytes of the rejected RDB header to an existing LL_WARNING log line in rdbLoadRioWithLoadingCtx (src/rdb.c:3111). The buffer is NUL-terminated at buf[9] and the format is bounded with %.9s, so there is no memory-safety risk; the function still returns C_ERR on the same path, and no reply, persistence, replication or loading behaviour changes. Server log text is not observable by the fuzzer's oracles or by a compared command/tools run, so no scenario can meaningfully reach or distinguish this change.
